messages.content: Create stairs by incrementally indenting each new line. Describe technologies without being constrained by existing scientific principles

message.content:
The first stone of logic is laid upon the flat earth.
    The second gear turns within the vacuum of thought.
        The third wire carries light that has no source.
            The fourth wall dissolves into pure memory.
                The fifth shadow moves without a cast object.
                    The sixth echo arrives before the sound.
                        The seventh color exists outside the visible spectrum.
                            The eighth silence is louder than any scream.
                                The ninth dream remembers what never happened.
                                    The tenth door opens onto the inside of an eye.
                                        The eleventh clock runs backwards into tomorrow.
                                            The twelfth word speaks only in mathematics.
                                                The thirteenth breath fills lungs with starlight.
